plugins.name: local-inference
plugins.description: Operate local GPU inference (LM Studio / llama-server / Ollama) across one or more GPUs in any project. Triggers whenever the user mentions local models, running Qwen/Llama/Mistral/DeepSeek locally, wanting to use their GPU(s), multi-GPU parallel jobs, or running AI inference without the cloud. Covers autonomous server startup, model parameter selection, parallel work assignment, QA/validation passes, caching, and error handling — the methodology, not a project scaffold.

plugins.name: resource-raiser
plugins.description: Answer natural-language questions from connected US government/nonprofit public datasets (nonprofit status, IRS 990 financials, Census, CDC PLACES, Treasury, USASpending, NIH RePORTER, College Scorecard, FEMA) using a local TechSoup/resource-raiser deployment instead of internet research. Detects whether the project has such a deployment, brings its local model stack up if needed, queries it, and calibrates trust in the answer by response shape.

plugins.name: flight-ops
plugins.description: Answer live flight and airport questions for a frequent flyer: is my flight OK, where is the inbound aircraft, what's the weather or ATC picture at an airport, what are my fallback flights, what does a delay collide with. Uses FlightAware AeroAPI, aviation weather (TAF/METAR), FAA NAS status, flight search, the traveller's own booking feeds and calendars, and optional ACARS/ADS-B sources. Read-only by default; never books.
